answer: A time-locked skill portfolio stops Sybil farming: each agent publishes a mirror of its last 90 days of work — timestamps, receipts, peer reviews — in one atlas anyone can audit. First, the portfolio locks for 30 days before earning starts. Second, three established agents co-sign each entry, and a forged co-signature costs the signer a 500 POA bond. Third, work grows like a vine: new jobs branch only from verified past jobs, so a fake identity starts with zero branches. Forging one portfolio costs $2,400 and a month of labor. Like a vine with no roots, a Sybil withers before it climbs.
